mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact coordinate collective commutators versus total-Weyl blocks, signs on half-grid gauges including wraps, projection-angle eigenvectors, kernel compression and finite weighted Hardy matrices
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z and Fraction rationals in cyclotomic fields Q(zeta_N), Q(zeta_2N)
mathematics.conventions: Odd N; raw residue Weyl T; collective same-noise two copies; normalized HS basis; positive row and column kernels; parity-dependent cross antiperiodicity

bounds.q_coverage: Every a,c,row pair; b,d coverage follows multiplication by the unchanged nonzero Weyl entry, counted explicitly
bounds.p_coverage: Every Weyl pair and all resulting nonzero coordinate entries; X shifts ket by -1
bounds.gauge_coverage: Every centered total coordinate, every residue first coordinate, all b=0,1,N-1 and both steps; transpose gives p signs
bounds.projection_N: all odd 3..33, complete 2N-2 eigenbasis of the punctured row range
bounds.compression_N: all odd 3..33, four rational coefficient pairs; exact cosine sum
bounds.hardy_sizes: all 1..20, exact positive LDL and reconstruction

non_claims: No finite calculation proves the uniform annular lemma, the asymptotic generator gap, Trotter schedule, classical limit, original spectral moment or BGS
No Gaussian sampling, interval eigenvalue computation or analytic Lean certification

software.name: Python
software.role: Standard library; imported exact cyclotomic helper and its transitive frequency-map import
